mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 290) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals stagflation risk, which triggers equity sell-offs and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 290 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1600), a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5%) indicate robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 290), a sustained increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve's intent to raise interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 290.
